params_that_helped.method: Fetch the public EIA Midwest weekly diesel history page, read the 52 latest values, and write a markdown table plus the CSV. Put the retrieval date on every row and figure. Flag any week missing from the latest release.
params_that_helped.done_when: CSV and a markdown table hold up to 52 Monday rows, each with series ID, URL and retrieved date; the newest published week is named; any missing week is flagged.
params_that_helped.limitation: EIA API was unavailable, so prices come from the public EIA history page; any week newer than its latest release is not covered.

params_that_helped.method: Use fetch_url on the EDB PDF and landing page; take date, versions, hardware and tables from the text. List each item not found as a gap.
params_that_helped.done_when: EDB URL, funder (EDB, vendor-funded) and every item found are recorded; each missing item (date, versions, hardware, tables, third benchmark, '17 times' context) is listed as a gap.
params_that_helped.limitation: The EDB whitepaper could not be read in full as a file, so any date, version, hardware or result table not in the fetched text is marked as a gap.
